prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the Royal Walls of Ceuta, Spain, at night. Honest moonlit treatment — no invented floodlighting. The massive stone fortification walls lying dark under moonlight and a starry sky, the sea-filled moat reflecting the moon, a faint warm city glow on the horizon, waves of the Mediterranean lapping the rocks. No identifiable people. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
